# nodes / maintenance

<!-- Generated by @virtbase/proxmox-api-generator. Do not edit. -->

1 operation.

### <span class="method-badge" data-method="PUT">PUT</span> `/nodes/{node}/maintenance`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).maintenance.$put()
```

Enable or disable maintenance mode for the node. Currently, this only requests the HA node maintenance mode.

Returns nothing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maintenance-mode` | `enable` \| `disable` | yes | Specifies whether the maintenance mode for the specified node should be enabled or disabled. |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
